# Motion

The spring primitives and the named motion tokens that pick one by job.

**Kind:** Foundation

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/styles/TokensMotion.mdx`

## Overview

All motion in PLUS is a spring ([Physics](?path=/docs/foundations-expression-motion-physics--docs)). A primitive is a stiffness and damping pair; a semantic token names the job, such as a fast spatial move or an appearance fade, and aliases one primitive.
